51226940.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human CA2 in pH 7 sodium phosphate buffer at 37 degC by isothermal titration calorimetry
51226940.references_previous: Dudutie V, et al. Discovery and characterization of novel selective inhibitors of carbonic anhydrase IX. J Med Chem. 2014;57:9435–9446.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC Measurements: ITC experiments (Fig. 2) have been performed to compare the dissociation constants obtained by FTSA: the standard deviation did not exceed ± 1.6-fold. The experiments were performed using VP-ITC at 37 °C and data were analyzed by Origin software. The heat of dilution has been subtracted from the titration. The protein and compound were diluted in 50 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) containing 100 mM sodium chloride, 2% (v/v) of DMSO to 10 and 100 μM, respectively.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Isothermal titration calorimetry results of CA II titrated with compound 12a (A) and 4 (B) at pH 7.0 in sodium phosphate buffer and 37 °C. Inserts show binding isotherms.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 data: Panel A: Kd = 318 nM, ΔH = -40.1 kJ/mol, ΔS = -5.1 kJ/(mol·K). Panel B: Kd = 697 nM, ΔH = -22.8 kJ/mol, ΔS = 44.3 kJ/(mol·K).
original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Protein preparat: Production and purification of recombinant human CAs has been previously described in 23 and their concentrations have been determined spectrophotometrically (at a wavelength of 280 nm).

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 50 mM sodium phosphate, 100 mM sodium chloride, 2% (v/v) DMSO
